synthesis_zh: 规则提供可证明的低复杂度路线；MCTS是否发现并持续执行路线是不同问题。
D0给出解析参照；M3显示预算提升使mixed短路线更常出现，但LL的保证求输路线在三个预算仍零观察。
M5的pass8干预改变轨迹和长度结构，LL黑目标仍59/60；它没有隔离komi，且很宽的预注册区间不支持精细归因或规则等价。
M6验证四格实现、和棋口径与成本，LL的贴目响应是值得正式检验的信号，尚不能从每格6局推出公平或稳定逆转。
M7应填补固定256预算、两个pass条件下komi效应及交互的正式估计；不得把显著性、全部mixed成功或原始前缀唯一当作复杂协调证明。
初始Goal允许在完整审计证据链、机制边界和最高信息增益下一诊断明确时，以有依据的7×7 NO-GO完成本轮；不是必须不停跑到GO。

analytical_deductions.claim: LL, pass0, komi2.5: black AlwaysPass guarantees utility +1 against every legal white response. On 5×5 it must end by action 50, never move_limit 100.
analytical_deductions.reason: Black never has stones or black-only territory. Black area is 0 and white score is at least 2.5. White can place at most 24 stones, and any white pass follows a black pass.
analytical_deductions.limits: An available contingent strategy is not demonstrated MCTS adoption. The scoring guarantee persists for larger boards under the same rules; the action-50 bound is specific to 5×5.

analytical_deductions.status: new logical deduction in this review; not an empirical M7 result
analytical_deductions.claim: LL, pass0, komi0 from empty: each player can guarantee utility at least 0 by always passing. AP/AP is a draw equilibrium, and the zero-sum value is 0.
analytical_deductions.reason: Never placing leaves own area 0 and opponent area nonnegative. Own color never wins, so LOSE utility is 0 or +1. Both guarantees force zero value; mutual pass gives (0,0).
analytical_deductions.limits: Does not imply finite MCTS finds the equilibrium, equal observed black/white success, fairness of other matchups, or a pass8 equilibrium. Removing komi removes the strict black +1 guarantee but leaves simple strategies.

analytical_deductions.status: new logical deduction in this review; not a counted endpoint
analytical_deductions.claim: At komi0/pass0, WL still has [a,P,P] in 3 actions; LW has [P,a,P,P] in 4 actions, with white-only area 25 and both goals +1.
analytical_deductions.reason: One-color area scoring assigns the connected empty region to the only stone color.
analytical_deductions.limits: Route existence only. No new frequency was calculated or appended to frozen analysis.

analytical_deductions.status: established in M4, M5 and M6
analytical_deductions.claim: pass8 forbids zero-based ply 0–7. First legal pass is action 9; earliest double-pass is action 10.
analytical_deductions.limits: The terminal lower bound is mechanical. Subtracting 8 from a length contrast does not remove changed board, tree, rollout or RNG effects.

remaining_uncertainties.question: Why does LL finite MCTS not sustain a provably optimal black all-pass strategy in positive-komi/pass0?
remaining_uncertainties.evidence: M3 LL actual all-pass0/60 at64,256,1024; black goals57,58,54 and mean lengths24.5,28.4833,46.1.
remaining_uncertainties.M7_resolution: No direct resolution: M7 keeps256 and does not evaluate counterfactual actions or future policy commitments.

remaining_uncertainties.question: How much does komi0 change LL black success at each pass setting, and does that change differ between settings?
remaining_uncertainties.evidence: M6 descriptive LL differences -0.5 and -0.8333, interaction-0.3333; each arm×direction n6.
remaining_uncertainties.M7_resolution: Directly addressable by fixed formal paired4-arm estimands and preregistered intervals; may remain quantitatively imprecise.

remaining_uncertainties.question: Do declines in LL black goals correspond to draws or opposite-color goal success?
remaining_uncertainties.evidence: M6 LL k0/p0 black3,white2,draw1; k0/p8 black1,white4,draw1 versus black6,white0,draw0 under2.5.
remaining_uncertainties.M7_resolution: Report all three categories and full utility distribution. A black-goal binary contrast alone is insufficient.

remaining_uncertainties.question: Is any apparent effect specific to LL or common to finite search under a changed score threshold?
remaining_uncertainties.evidence: M6 WW p8 black goals5/6→1/6 also changed; pilot too small.
remaining_uncertainties.M7_resolution: Keep WW and mixed comparators separate; secondary contrasts remain secondary, and absence of precision is not absence of effect.

remaining_uncertainties.question: Does mixed success after early-pass restriction represent nontrivial interaction?
remaining_uncertainties.evidence: M5 LW9/60 ataction10; eight of those fixed boards draw under0komi. M6 k0pass8 LW g000082 still succeeds at10.
remaining_uncertainties.M7_resolution: Can estimate survival of success and near-boundary routes; cannot identify communication intent or rule out alternative simple policies.

remaining_uncertainties.question: Is there a balancing komi K_LL, monotonic dose response, or a transferable learning phenomenon?
remaining_uncertainties.evidence: Only komi0/2.5; fixed public identities and no learning.
remaining_uncertainties.M7_resolution: Cannot resolve: two-point contrasts do not identify curve shape, K_LL, other agents, new budgets, or learning.

remaining_uncertainties.question: Would 7×7 test anything beyond an already scale-invariant scoring shortcut?
remaining_uncertainties.evidence: Positive-komi AP proof is board-size independent; no7×7 cost/branching/termination protocol.
remaining_uncertainties.M7_resolution: Mechanism evidence may inform a hypothesis, but does not itself supply7×7 validation or resource calibration.

primary_estimands: LL black goal: komi0 minus komi2.5 at pass0
LL black goal: komi0 minus komi2.5 at pass8
Interaction: (komi effect at pass8) minus (komi effect at pass0)
requirements: Use the eventual frozen preregistration, not this review, as authority for sample and inference.
Do not pool M6 into M7. Use complete within-block four-arm contrasts; never pair old and new games.
Retain draws in all denominators. For WW and LL, black success + white success + draw = 1. Neither goal succeeds on a draw.
Pooled intervals concern six fixed seed-by-color strata under the stated hypothetical independent-stream model. Three seed labels do not represent all possible seeds.
Report per-seed estimates with the correct uncertainty scope. Point-sign consistency is not generalization; every single-seed interval need not exclude zero for a pooled conclusion.
The exact confidence family and interaction method must come from the frozen protocol and independently audited arithmetic.
Formal inference waits for all 960 saved and validated records. Do not retrofit sample size, safety stops, or interval methods after interim outcomes.
If intervals exclude zero, state the direction for this finite-search rule intervention. If they cross zero, retain the supported range rather than declaring no effect.
Result-driven new contrasts are exploratory and separate. Do not substitute a narrower method after seeing results.
Komi changes payoffs and search trajectories. Total rule effects do not identify a percentage attribution to scoring alone versus search.
can_resolve: Formal LL komi differences and interaction under the fixed 5×5, 256-simulation design.
Draw shifts versus opposite-color goal gains.
Descriptive seed heterogeneity, near-earliest routes, payoff-conditioned pass events, lengths and tails in all four arms.
cannot_resolve: Why a specific action or captured stone was chosen; original Q is not a calibrated probability.
Optimality, minimax convergence, persistence of an all-pass plan, or separation of rollout bias from low-visit noise.
Komi monotonicity or fairness, arbitrary new-seed/agent/budget guarantees, or 7×7 migration.
A causal mediation fraction for shared goals versus early pass, or complex communication from shorter length alone.

pre_result_outcome_cases.case: Both LL komi contrasts are robustly negative and interaction excludes zero.
pre_result_outcome_cases.reading: Komi changes LL success and the pass window modifies that change under the fixed design. Decompose draws and opposite-color successes.
pre_result_outcome_cases.next: Do not automatically expand. Close the initial Goal with a supported NO-GO if other gates fail; nominate D3.

pre_result_outcome_cases.case: Both LL contrasts are negative, but interaction remains imprecise.
pre_result_outcome_cases.reading: Support simple effects where intervals allow, but do not claim that their magnitudes differ.
pre_result_outcome_cases.next: Further interaction-only research is optional, not mandatory Goal completion.

pre_result_outcome_cases.case: One or both contrasts are imprecise or vary across seeds.
pre_result_outcome_cases.reading: The pilot signal did not yield a precise conclusion in this design. An uncertain result is valid evidence.
pre_result_outcome_cases.next: Do not select a favorable endpoint or automatically double n. Prefer D3 if it targets the unresolved search mechanism.

pre_result_outcome_cases.case: Mixed success and successful near-boundary routes persist.
pre_result_outcome_cases.reading: This supports common-payoff terminal planning and weighs against calling pass8/komi0 a shortcut-free benchmark.
pre_result_outcome_cases.next: Maintain NO-GO for a nontrivial-coordination migration; do not automatically escalate rules.

7x7_gate_review.criterion: D0/D1 clarify shallow search versus analytic shortcuts.
7x7_gate_review.evidence: D0 guarantees and M3 mixed-route growth are established; LL nonadoption is not explained.

7x7_gate_review.criterion: At least one pass or komi mechanism contrast.
7x7_gate_review.status_before_M7: met as an experiment, with coarse precision
7x7_gate_review.evidence: M5 formal pass8 comparison is complete. M7 adds formal komi and interaction estimates if fully validated.

7x7_gate_review.criterion: Key directions replicated across at least three independent batch seeds.
7x7_gate_review.evidence: M3 mixed 1024−64 route differences are positive in seeds 5/6/7. M5 LL/WL/LW raw-length differences are positive in 11/12/13. This does not certify all endpoints.

7x7_gate_review.criterion: At least 256 simulations and explanation of contrary budget behavior.
7x7_gate_review.evidence: M3, M5 and M6 include 256. LL length and all-pass nonadoption at 1024 remain unresolved.

7x7_gate_review.criterion: For nontrivial coordination, evidence beyond simple terminal routes.
7x7_gate_review.evidence: M5 and M6 retain post-window cheap routes. Full mixed success and diverse exact coordinates do not establish complex coordination.

7x7_gate_review.criterion: A falsifiable 7×7 prediction plus branching, budget, termination and cost assessment.
7x7_gate_review.evidence: No such final protocol or cost pilot is in the reviewed evidence. M7 does not supply it automatically.

goal_completion_and_stopping.completion_clause: A verifiable evidence chain explaining major 5×5 mechanisms, at least one validated diagnostic–analysis–decision cycle, and a data-supported 7×7 GO/NO-GO. For NO-GO, state the remaining uncertainties and highest-information next experiment.
goal_completion_and_stopping.recommended_endpoint: After full M7 validation and an integrated report, the initial mechanism/decision Goal can be complete with NO-GO. D3 is a next-research recommendation, not an obligation to start another run.
not_required: A nonzero result in every contrast
Learning, neural training, 9×9, or indefinite iteration
goal_completion_and_stopping.avoid_endless_cycle: A remaining scientific uncertainty does not itself mean the requested decision task is incomplete. Another experiment needs its own scope, preregistration, resource review and applicable authorization.

highest_information_next_5x5_diagnostic.name: D3 bounded LL action and continuation audit
highest_information_next_5x5_diagnostic.status: Proposal only. Not preregistered or run.
highest_information_next_5x5_diagnostic.why: M7 fills the rule-factor gap, but another whole-game factorial batch cannot directly explain why finite MCTS fails to sustain a guaranteed all-pass outcome. Exact all-pass and immediate-terminal oracles make a small state panel informative.
highest_information_next_5x5_diagnostic.question: On the same complete state, is the chosen action stable across independent higher-budget searches, and do disagreements with certified pass/commitment payoffs reflect noisy search or the continuation policy being evaluated?

panel_candidate.strata: Three M7 batch seeds × four arms × two event types. Select the lowest game_index, then earliest eligible ply, within each stratum. Deduplicate identical complete states while retaining stratum labels.
event_types: First black nonpass decision when black has no stones and pass is legal; mark whether positive komi supplies the exact +1 sustained-pass guarantee.
First white refusal of a black-goal-favorable pass proposal. Immediate second-pass payoff is exact, even when future values are not.
panel_candidate.anchors: Empty LL/pass0 at komi2.5 and komi0. These are two different rule states, not extra independent boards for each RNG seed.
panel_candidate.missing_stratum_policy: Report absent events. Do not relax selection or search other datasets after seeing evaluations.
complete_state_fields: source game/ply and original root records

evaluation_candidate.budget_stability: Repeat unchanged original MCTS at 256 and 4096 simulations using eight predeclared independent RNG streams per state. Preserve every legal action, visits, Q, choice, and unvisited actions.
evaluation_candidate.continuation_diagnostic: Separately evaluate every legal candidate using 1024 equal-budget, independent forced-first-action uniform continuations. This estimates a specified rollout-policy value, not minimax action value. Compare it with exact second-pass payoffs and valid sustained-pass guarantees.
evaluation_candidate.commitment_boundary: A future AlwaysPass guarantee is a policy commitment, not the payoff of one pass followed by uniform random actions. A separately named sustained-pass diagnostic must not replace or relabel G0.
evaluation_candidate.work_bound: 26 × [8 × (256 + 4096) + 26 × 1024]. Actual legal-action counts may reduce work. This is not a wall-time promise.
evaluation_candidate.interpretation: Stable higher-budget choices that still fail to preserve a certified guarantee suggest a continuation-policy blind spot; large across-stream changes suggest finite-budget instability. Either can coexist. Neither diagnostic alone proves every source of error is identified.

endpoints: Per-root actor-utility estimates with draws valued zero, under explicitly named continuation policies.
Action-selection frequencies, pass/nonpass reversals and visit coverage across fixed streams and budgets.
Exact immediate-terminal oracle contradictions, separately from differences against a future-policy guarantee.
Stratum-specific results; purposive roots do not estimate population event frequencies.
highest_information_next_5x5_diagnostic.cost_and_stop: Before running, perform separate small cost-only calibration and freeze final selection, budgets, streams, methods and resource ceiling. A proposed four-hour child-compute ceiling must be checked, not promised. Stop at the fixed panel even if unresolved; safety failures remain incomplete evidence. No automatic expansion or 7×7.
not_proven: Original Q as a calibrated probability
Population frequencies from a selected panel
Nontrivial coordination or 7×7 GO without separate gates

final_M7_report_review_checklist: 960/960 strict complete validation, source and plan locks, independent final audit, preregistered regeneration, final tests and historical preservation.
Exact three LL primary estimands and correct family intervals; four-arm within-block dependence retained for interaction.
Correct denominators: n=60 per arm/direction and n=20 per seed/arm/direction. All three outcomes retained; mixed success counted once.
M7 results replace placeholders. No reuse of M6 effect sizes as formal evidence and no cross-milestone pooled n.
M5 wide intervals and M3 budget-specific evidence stay qualified. Rule effects remain distinct from fixed-board rescoring and analytic existence proofs.
Lengths, tails, near-boundary routes, raw/END prefix denominators, pass-event dependence and Q limits are explicit.
Explicit gate-by-gate 7×7 verdict, why NO-GO can complete the initial Goal, and one bounded highest-information next diagnostic.
Child compute is distinguished from calendar time, synchronization waits, tests, replay and regeneration. No invented GitHub CI claim.
Narrative stays outside the repository. This review worker performs no publication.
